alternate_mechanisms.name: received_lineage_versus_self_made_prestige
alternate_mechanisms.summary: Parentage, offspring, household kin, intimate companions, and recognized chiefs precede the boast. The speaker treats lineage, merits, and wealth as self-owned prestige, but the oath exposes status as received and relational before it can be verbally appropriated as personal immunity.

alternate_mechanisms.name: divine_creation_versus_human_fabrication
alternate_mechanisms.summary: Divine agency creates the person and makes the organ that tests appearances. Human agency answers by fabricating, naming, and circulating an impressive account of loss. The contrast is between ontological making and rhetorical making: one equips judgment, while the other seeks to evade it.

alternate_mechanisms.name: boasted_expenditure_and_relational_ruin
alternate_mechanisms.summary: Once expenditure is entered into an allocation account, magnitude is not its only measure. Destroyed wealth can reduce sufficiency, produce need, and harm a household; the boast's public prestige is therefore tested against what remains available to the relationships that sustain the speaker.

alternate_mechanisms.name: generation_requires_habitat_and_nurture
alternate_mechanisms.summary: Begetting expands into a material cycle of fertility, gestation becoming visible, lactation, nourishment, habitat, and dependent young. The animal particulars are exploratory, but the mechanism reinforces the passage's denial of autonomy: generated life requires place and provision before it can boast of power.

alternate_mechanisms.name: inhabited_city_defeats_social_invisibility
alternate_mechanisms.summary: Residence places the claimant among present people in a field of mutual visibility and possible information gathering. His claim that no one saw him is therefore socially unstable even before divine witness is considered; no actual crowd, confrontation, or scout is inserted into the scene.

alternate_mechanisms.name: the_eye_between_care_and_surveillance
alternate_mechanisms.summary: The made eyes open two accountability poles: face-to-face proof and monitoring on one side, watchful protection and merciful attention on the other. Under the basmala, being seen is not reducible to hostile surveillance; it can also mean that created hardship is known and cared for.

alternate_mechanisms.name: the_apportioned_face_as_counterevidence
alternate_mechanisms.summary: Proportioned form, facial spacing, the reflected human image, visible appearance, and paired eyes make the claimant's own face a designed field of evidence. The one who imagines unbounded power and unseen action bears measure and visibility in his created morphology; no beauty judgment or eyebrow description is asserted on the surface.
